signature: SUBROUTINE DGELQT( M, N, MB, A, LDA, T, LDT, WORK, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: mb
params.reference: The block size to be used in the blocked QR. $\min (M,N) \ge \mathrm{MB} \ge 1$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix A. On exit, the elements on and below the diagonal of the array contain the M-by-MIN(M,N) lower trapezoidal matrix L (L is lower triangular if $M \le N$); the elements above the diagonal are the rows of V.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The upper triangular block reflectors stored in compact form as a sequence of upper triangular blocks. See below for further details.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \mathrm{MB}$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

checks.js: mb < 1 || (mb > min( M, N ) && min( M, N ) > 0)
